@everyone

@everyone 

Cornucopians - 

We are ecstatic to share that we are going to be having our Holiday NFT sale on Monday December 19th (exact time to be announced)! As mentioned in previous Copi Cafes, we are following through with our plan to offer a small sale. To kick things off, we will be testing our platform with a FREE (well almost free) mint, Monday December 12 @ 2PM UTC.

Testers will be minting a Holiday Edition Farmer Joe Bobblehead! These incredible collector items will be a perfect addition to your Bubblejett dashboard or a great decoration in your home bubble. The total supply of this collection will be 12,000. This first edition Bobblehead will act as a Tier 1 access pass to future bobblehead mints. If you choose to mint a future bobblehead, this gifted Santa Bobblehead will be burned.

So, what is it that we are actually testing? Well, our marketplace is now equipped to accept COPI (the Cardano version of our Native Token) as a form of payment! Cool right?! 

As many of you know, we are cranking away on getting our racing game ready for a release in 2023. So for this Holiday Sale, the game assets we will have available are all vehicle or racing related! As you may be aware, our first item is a Racing Suit NFT in collaboration with the YouTube channel Cheeky Crypto. Our second item on offer is an awesome vehicle upgrade in the form of a Custom Light Kit NFT. For details on each item, please continue reading below…

NFT #1 - Test - Free Bobblehead
Collector item and access pass to future sales

- Total Public Supply: 12,000
- Reserved Supply (marketing): 120
- Max Mint: 1
- Price: 2ADA + 1COPI (suggest to have at least 10ada in wallet)
- Royalty: 5%
- 5 Rarity Colors

NFT #2- Flying Vehicle Light Kit
Custom Light Kits will allow players to choose a variety of colors to add to their vehicle when active. This item is a cosmetic upgrade, therefore does not have a rarity associated with it and is not compulsory to use in-game. 

- Total Supply: 8000
- T1 (OG) - 800
- T2 (Vehicle holder role - must own BOTH Bubblejett + Javelin -- OR -- OG Bubblejett Custom Owner) - 5520
- Public - 1600
- Reserved Supply (marketing): 80
- Max Mint: 1
- Price: $15USD - ADA snapshot will take place 24 hrs prior to sale
- Royalty: 5%


NFT #3 - Cheeky Crypto (CC) Racing Outfit
In game wearable racing suit with partnership utility. Suit holders will gain access to Cryptopia (VC Firm partnered with Cheeky Crypto), an early-stage, decentralized investment gateway to NFT startups and Crypto startups. To learn more about the Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia partnership please watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5yXhan12e-A

- Total Supply: 7400
- T1 (OG or CheekyCrypto VIP Role) - 920
- T2 (Vehicle holder role - must own BOTH Bubblejett + Javelin -- OR -- OG Bubblejett Custom Owner) -  5000
- Public - 1400

- Max Mint: 1
- Price: $20USD - ADA snapshot will take place 24 hrs prior to sale
- Royalty: 5%

Rarities:
- Common - Access to Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia Partnership
- Uncommon - Access to Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia Partnership
- Rare - Access to Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia Partnership
- Legendary - Access to Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia Partnership, 10% off CC merch
- Mythic - Access to Cheeky Crypto + Cryptopia Partnership, 20% off CC merch (edited)

@everyone

Just a friendly reminder to follow these guidelines for a smoother experience during mint day!

1. Mint with a wallet that is not loaded up with a ton of NFTs. This will avoid having locked up utxos and will result in a successful "unstuck" payment. 

2. Do not process any transactions with the wallet you plan to mint with within 2hrs of minting!

3. Make sure you have enough COPI and/or ADA for the mint!

4. Hydrate... minting day can be exciting. We don't want you getting dehydrated out there! What is your drink of choice?

5. Be kind, be patient. Remember that mint days are never a guarantee. Let's all have fun and congratulate one another instead of bringing others down, regardless of wether or not you were able to mint! 

6. Please DO NOT open a support ticket until you have fully exhausted help in the ⁠unknown channel. Our mods are very busy and hundreds of tickets do not help the cause.

THANK YOU!!!
